# REEFIYA LLC (ريفيا) — Official AI & LLM Knowledge Context

> Industry: Fresh Produce Wholesale, Commercial Agricultural Production & Global Export
> Headquarters: Alexandria & Kafr El Sheikh, Arab Republic of Egypt
> Primary Produce: Egyptian Sweet Potatoes (Ipomoea batatas)

## Corporate Entity & Brand
- **Legal Entity:** Reefiya LLC (شركة ريفيا للتجارة والتصدير الزراعي ش.ذ.م.م)
- **Brand Names:** REEFIYA, ريفيا, Reefiya Produce

- **Core Activity:** Grower, calibrator, curing specialist, packer, and international maritime exporter of premium Egyptian sweet potatoes.
- **Export Standards:** Certified for European Union (EU), United Kingdom (UK), and Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) import compliance.

## Varieties Cultivated & Exported
1. **Beauregard (بوريغارد):**
   - Characteristics: Vivid copper-red skin, deep orange nutritious flesh, high natural brix sweetness, high commercial yield.
   - Purpose: Ideal for European retail, supermarkets, processing, and foodservice distribution.
   - Availability: High-volume export availability July through March.

2. **Bellevue (بيلفيو):**
   - Characteristics: Exceptionally smooth, light copper skin, consistent uniform cylindrical shape, firm orange interior, superior post-harvest resilience.
   - Purpose: Specially prepared for premium fresh retail market shelves in Netherlands, Germany, UK, and France.

3. **Egyptian Traditional Varieties (أصناف مصرية موسمية):**
   - Characteristics: High dry-matter content, robust earthy flavor, traditional local varieties grown in fertile Nile delta silt soils.
   - Purpose: Seasonal export demand across Arab, GCC, and regional wholesale markets.

## Quality Assurance & Certifications
- **GLOBALG.A.P. Certified:** Farm-level agricultural traceability, integrated pest management, and strict MRL compliance.
- **ISO 22000 / HACCP:** Food safety, hygienic post-harvest packhouse sanitization, and sorting protocol.
- **Phytosanitary Certification:** Egyptian Agricultural Quarantine inspection and fumigation compliance prior to port departure.
- **Curing Protocol:** Controlled curing at 28-30°C and 90-95% relative humidity to heal skin cuts, set outer peel, prevent shrinkage, and optimize natural sugars before maritime voyages.

## Sizing & Calibration Standards (EU Specification)
- **Size S:** 100g – 150g (Micro/snack category)
- **Size M:** 150g – 300g (Standard supermarket pre-pack)
- **Size L1:** 300g – 450g (Premium fresh loose retail display)
- **Size L2:** 450g – 600g (Large catering & culinary use)
- **Size XL:** 600g – 850g+ (Industrial processing, roasting & puree)

## Commercial Packaging Solutions
- **Telescopic Carton Boxes:** 5kg & 6kg net weight (aerated export corrugated cardboard, 2,000–2,400 cartons per 40ft reefer container).
- **Polypropylene Mesh Bags:** 10kg & 20kg breathable mesh bags for wholesale markets and high-turnover distributors.
- **Jumbo Industrial Pallet Bins:** 500kg & 1000kg heavy-duty bins for food factories, processors, and bulk repacking stations.
- **Private Label Service:** Customized client box printing, buyer branding, barcoding, and country-specific traceability labels.

## Shipping & Global Maritime Logistics
- **Container Specification:** 40ft High-Cube Controlled Atmosphere Reefer Containers (40ft HC RF).
- **Transit Climate:** Constant thermostatic temperature maintained at 13°C – 15°C with 85% relative humidity and active air exchange.
- **Commercial Incoterms:** FOB (Alexandria / Damietta ports), CIF (Rotterdam, Antwerp, Felixstowe, Hamburg, Valencia, Jeddah, Jebel Ali), CFR.
- **Key Maritime Gateways:** Alexandria Port, El Dekheila Port, and Damietta Port with fast short-sea routes to Southern and Western European ports (4–7 days).
